title: Ileana: The Andromeda Galaxy
text:
Ileana: the Andromeda Galaxy,

700,000 light-years away,

which can be seen with the naked eye on a clear night,

is closer than you.

Other solitary eyes will be looking at me from Andromeda

in their night. I do not see you.

Ileana: distance is time, and time flies.

At 200 million miles per hour the universe

is expanding toward Nothingness.

And you are far from me as if millions of years away.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the cosmic scale as a measure of romantic distance.

title: Have You Not Read, My Love...
text:
Have you not read, my love,

in NOVEDADES:


SENTINEL OF PEACE

GENIUS OF LABOR

CHAMPION OF DEMOCRACY

IN AMERICA

DEFENDER OF CATHOLICISM

IN AMERICA

THE PROTECTOR OF THE PEOPLE

THE BENEFACTOR...?


They plunder the people

of their language.


And they falsify the words

of the people.


(Exactly like the

people's money)


That is why poets

polish a poem so much


And that is why

my love poems are so important.
editorial_note: The translation preserves the propaganda headlines and the turn toward poetry as linguistic resistance.

title: Psalm 1
text:
Blessed is the man who does not follow the Party's slogans

nor attend its rallies

nor sit at the table with the gangsters

nor with the Generals on the War Council

Blessed is the man who does not spy on his brother

nor denounce his schoolmate

Blessed is the man who does not read the commercial advertisements

nor listen to their radios

nor believe in their slogans.


He will be like a tree planted beside a spring.
editorial_note: The translation keeps the biblical psalm form recast against party propaganda and denunciation.

title: 1. Here He Passed on Foot Through These Streets, Without Work or Position...
text:
Somoza unveils the statue of Somoza in Somoza Stadium



        It is not that I believe the people raised this statue for me

        because I know better than you that I ordered it myself.

        Nor that I intend to pass with it into posterity

        because I know the people will tear it down one day.

        Nor that I wanted to raise for myself while alive

        the monument you will not raise for me when dead:

        rather I raised this statue because I know you hate it.
editorial_note: The queued catalog title differs from the body; the translation preserves both the metadata title and the visible Somoza-stadium text.
